environment.description: Node.js 18 Apollo GraphQL server deployed on EC2 behind an ALB with public internet access. The /tmp/documents and /tmp/exports directories are on an EBS volume shared with a sidecar container that processes uploads. The sidecar runs as the same user and can create symlinks in both directories. No authentication middleware is configured on the GraphQL endpoint. ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 to the target group without request inspection.

config.network: Public ALB -> EC2 target group, port 4000
config.filesystem: EBS gp3 volume mounted at /tmp, shared with sidecar container via ECS task
config.auth: None - GraphQL endpoint is publicly accessible
config.iam: EC2 instance role with S3 and CloudWatch permissions only
config.symlink_creation: Sidecar container or any process with write access to /tmp/documents can create symlinks
